Axiom: When proposing scope or module candidates, draw the boundary along three axes, never mixed into one unit: data / domain (business rules, state, persistence) ↔ UI / presentation (view, rendering, user interaction) ↔ infrastructure (transport, deployment, third-party wiring). A candidate spanning two axes is a signal to split it, not a shortcut to take. A shared core is extracted from these axes only once ≥2 real consumers need it — never speculatively (`AX_YAGNI_OVERENGINEERING_GUARD`); a single consumer stays inline.
